name: To Love & Protect
source:
One minute you are a normal college student, the next, you are the secret love child of the President of the United States! When you are attacked by your father’s enemies you are assigned a Secret Service team to protect you! But who’s going to protect your heart from them?!

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/163425785845/to-love-protect-out-now-one-minute-you-are-a]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
translation:
前一分钟，你还是一名普通大学生；下一分钟，你就成了美国总统的私生子！遭到父亲的敌人袭击后，一支特勤局小队被派来保护你！但谁来保护你的心不被他们夺走？！

[来源：[url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/163425785845/to-love-protect-out-now-one-minute-you-are-a]Voltage Lovestruck博客[/url]]
